companyDescription: MS biotech · vidofludimus calcium (oral DHODH inhibitor) in twin Phase 3 ENSURE-1/ENSURE-2 trials for relapsing MS, topline guided to December 2026 · ~$132M cash (Sep 30) vs a ~$102M market cap · NDA planned mid-2027 if positive

summary: A true binary: twin Phase 3 ENSURE-1/ENSURE-2 readouts of oral vidofludimus in relapsing MS are guided to December 2026 (Q3 release). The company trades at ~$102M against ~$132M cash at Sep 30, so the market prices meaningful failure odds. H.C. Wainwright's $22 target implies ~+190%. Runway is guided into late 2027 (~12–13 months), plus up to ~$200M from outstanding warrants, so there is no survival flag. The bar is high: ENSURE compares against the active comparator teriflunomide, not placebo. phase3_readout has n<5 in the turbo prior (context only). Base +110% is a post-readout horizon, not a 30-day call. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า ENSURE พลาด ลงได้ 55–70%.

catalysts.name: ENSURE-1 / ENSURE-2 Phase 3 topline (relapsing MS)
catalysts.description: Twin pivotal trials of vidofludimus calcium vs teriflunomide in relapsing MS, primary endpoint annualized relapse rate. The company reaffirmed topline in December 2026 in its Q3 2026 update, with both studies on track. No exact day guided.

catalysts.name: NDA submission (if ENSURE positive)
catalysts.description: Subject to positive data, Immunic plans an NDA in mid-2027, which could lead to approval in 2028. A partnering or licensing deal is the more likely near-term monetization for a ~$100M company.

risks: Active-comparator bar: ENSURE tests vidofludimus against teriflunomide, an approved oral MS drug (same DHODH mechanism class). Beating it on relapse rate is harder than beating placebo, and a 'non-inferior but not superior' result would be read as a miss.
Binary single-asset company: if both trials miss, the equity is priced toward a cash shell, with burn continuing.
Financing overhang: the Feb 12, 2026 securities purchase agreement drove the 1-for-10 reverse split, and outstanding warrants (up to ~$200M) could dilute holders heavily on positive data.
Runway is ~12–13 months (guided into late 2027). That is enough to read out, but not to launch alone, so a raise or partnership is needed either way.
Small-cap biotech risk appetite: macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26. A hot Oct PCE (Nov 25) would hit XBI/IWM into the readout window.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next — both land inside the readout window.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset biotech: the ENSURE readout dominates. Rates matter only through small-cap biotech appetite and the price of any post-data raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the outcome is idiosyncratic, but macro is WAIT (30/100) and small caps sell first on a hot PCE. Use the dip entry and keep size small.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2% max — a dated December binary priced below cash. The measured turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($6.90–7.35) is preferred. Size for a gap: a readout lands overnight, so stops will not save a miss.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Small-cap biotechs with a dated pivotal readout often drift up 2–4 weeks before the event. IMUX has done the opposite (-46% since July and -5% post-Q3), so positioning is light.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Final 2–4 weeks before the December readout

postWin.note: MDGL rose ~268% in one session on a clean Phase 3 (MAESTRO-NASH, Dec 2022); CAPR ran ~+300% in two days on HOPE-3 (Dec 2025). A below-cash company with a twin-trial win in a large indication fits the upper half of that range.

postLose.note: EYPT fell ~71% on its LUGANO Phase 3 miss (Aug 2026); CMPS fell ~36% on a Phase 3 that hit but disappointed on effect size (Jun 2025). Cash support limits the floor somewhat for IMUX.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. phase3_readout has no n≥5 turbo bucket (context only), so the lane-wide prior governs (hitRate 6.5%, softHitRate 27.1%). It is binary with an overnight gap, and macro is WAIT, so size at the floor.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If either trial fails superiority on ARR, exit day 1 — no 'wait for the full data' bounce.
